name: Wałcz (Poland)
description: Light blue field with white and red horizontal stripes across the lower half.
history: Polish Wikipedia describes the current city flag, established by resolution No. VI/SXXXIX/228/13 of 17 September 2013 and re-established on 26 February 2019, as a light blue field with the charge from the arms; this file shows the plain striped version.
